TARIL (21.84% promoter pledge) and ORIANA-SM (adjusted debt to net worth 1.23) are exited on red lines.
NETWEB is cut to 19 shares before its Saturday 24 October results; MANORAMA's trigger at 1,824.00 has already fired.
Effective market exposure falls from 88.3% to 53.9%; first orders can fill on Wednesday 21 October.

entries.summary: India is in a Downtrend: hold cash at the top of its band, add no new momentum longs, and treat Union Bank of India, Punjab National Bank and Persistent Systems as conditional setups at zero size until the Nifty 50 closes above its 50-day average of 23,514.27 for three sessions.

Watch 22,500 (put wall), 23,076.90 and 23,514.27 on the Nifty 50; results: NETWEB 24 Oct, APARINDS and LAURUSLABS 29 Oct
